🔥 httptrafficmonitr | C#
🎯 Primary Use Case: To capture, inspect, filter, replay, mock, and export HTTP/HTTPS traffic on Windows, with advanced control and automation capabilities for developers and AI assistants.
✨ Key Features: • System-wide HTTP/HTTPS capture with TLS interception • Live request grid with filtering and search • Detailed request/response inspection tabs (Request, Response, Timing, Certificate, Decoded) • Advanced multi-condition filtering with saved presets
📖 Summary: HTTP Traffic Monitor is a Windows desktop application that functions as a man-in-the-middle proxy for capturing, inspecting, and manipulating HTTP/HTTPS traffic. It features a WPF-based UI for detailed analysis and an MCP server interface for AI assistants to control and interact with the traffic data.
